I7 (the doc overstated a packaging-mechanism guarantee) rather than I6(a) false-assurance (no SECURITY or data-integrity control was misrepresented) -- derives MEDIUM/SHOULD cleanly, consistent with F-UP4-02-residual's own MEDIUM read of the underlying gap. IMPACT I6 (mechanism gap: re-audit has no committed date), EXPOSURE E6 -- the wrong outcome (a stale grant reactivating) is PROVEN unable to occur in production today: classify_and_authorize_dispatch refuses security.vuln_scan.* as Unclassified at the chokepoint before has_permission/RBAC is ever consulted, so there is no live path from the grant to an effect. E6 caps at LOW regardless of IMPACT, so this derives NICE despite compliance-officer's own SHOULD label -- recorded as the honest derivation, not silently taken at the reporter's word. Still flagged in the final report since a committed collector-PR date is a real gap, just not a gating one; no issue filed under this task's hard stop-line.
